rubrics.justification: Uses the provided 3AB grade appropriately and gives a cautious image-based read, but notes uncertainty and includes some speculative statements about limited ICM/TE visibility and stage nomenclature.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior IVF outcomes, BMI, endometrium, and partner factors well, though some interactions are discussed somewhat generally.
Overall logic is reasonable, but the response contains internal inconsistency in implantation estimates (25-35%, 30-40%) and some speculative comments that weaken coherence.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF practice, including SET and avoiding unsupported add-ons, though a few comments about culture optimization/endometriosis are less guideline-grounded.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, uterine evaluation, and future-cycle planning, but some recommendations remain broad rather than tightly case-specific.
